title: Session tokens do not expire after password reset
description: Active sessions remain valid after a user resets their password, allowing continued access with a compromised session token.

title: Verbose error messages expose stack traces
description: Unhandled exceptions return full stack traces to the client, disclosing internal implementation details.

title: Missing rate limiting on login endpoint
description: The login endpoint does not throttle repeated failed attempts from the same source.

title: Outdated TLS cipher suites accepted
description: The load balancer still accepts several deprecated TLS 1.1 cipher suites for backward compatibility.

title: Hardcoded JWT signing secret found in configuration
description: A static JWT signing secret is committed in the application's configuration file rather than sourced from a secrets manager.

title: Refunds API missing authorization check on account ownership
description: The refunds endpoint does not verify that the authenticated caller owns the account associated with the refund request.

title: Payment amount validated only on client side
description: Server-side validation of the payment amount field is missing, relying solely on client-side checks.

title: Customer PII exportable without approval workflow
description: Any CRM user can export full customer records to CSV without a manager approval step.

title: Model decision logs retained indefinitely
description: Fraud scoring decision logs, including customer PII, are retained with no defined deletion policy.

title: No documented model change approval process
description: Updates to the fraud scoring model are deployed without a documented review or sign-off process.

title: API rate limiting not enforced on refunds endpoint
description: The refunds API accepts an unbounded number of requests per client, with no rate limiting or throttling.

title: API responses include internal correlation IDs
description: Internal request-tracing identifiers are returned in API error responses, which are not needed by API consumers.

title: Critical OS patches missing on 3 production hosts
description: Three production servers are missing security patches released more than 90 days ago, including a remote code execution fix.

title: Default SNMP community string in use
description: The core switch is configured with the default 'public' SNMP community string.

title: Root login permitted over SSH
description: Direct root login over SSH is enabled on a production Linux host.

title: Security group allows inbound SSH from 0.0.0.0/0
description: An EC2 security group in the production account permits SSH access from any source IP address.

title: CloudTrail logging disabled in one region
description: CloudTrail is not enabled in one of the secondary AWS regions used for disaster recovery.

title: S3 bucket policy allows public read access
description: The fraud model artifacts S3 bucket was configured with a public-read bucket policy.

title: IAM users with unused access keys older than 180 days
description: Several IAM users retain access keys that have not been rotated or used in over 180 days.

title: Password complexity policy not enforced
description: Users can set passwords that do not meet the organization's minimum complexity requirements.

title: MFA not enforced for administrative accounts
description: Administrative accounts can sign in with a password only, without multi-factor authentication.

title: Biometric login fallback allows unlimited PIN attempts
description: When biometric authentication fails, the app falls back to a PIN with no attempt limit or lockout.

title: Transfer confirmation screen displays full account number
description: The transfer confirmation screen shows the full destination account number instead of a masked version.

title: Refresh tokens never expire
description: Issued refresh tokens have no expiry, allowing indefinite session renewal if a token is leaked.

title: Uploaded documents not scanned for malware
description: The document upload pipeline does not run an antivirus/malware scan before storing files.

title: Webhook endpoint does not validate signature
description: Inbound webhook payloads are processed without verifying an HMAC signature, allowing spoofed events.

title: Single approver can both create and authorize settlements
description: The settlement workflow does not enforce maker-checker segregation of duties, allowing one user to both initiate and approve high-value transfers.

title: Applicant SSN stored in plaintext in application logs
description: Loan application logs include the applicant's social security number in cleartext.

title: Service account credentials shared across integration jobs
description: A single service account credential is reused across multiple unrelated integration jobs, making revocation and auditing difficult.

title: Cache headers allow caching of authenticated responses
description: Some authenticated API responses are served with cache-control headers that permit shared caching.

title: Batch job runs with root privileges unnecessarily
description: Nightly batch jobs execute as root when the file operations they perform do not require elevated privileges.

title: SFTP transfers use password authentication only
description: File transfers to the batch server rely on password-based SFTP authentication rather than key-based auth.

title: Analyst role has write access to raw ingestion tables
description: The read-only analyst role is inadvertently granted write access to the raw data ingestion tables.

title: Database audit logging not enabled
description: Native database audit logging is disabled on the core banking database, limiting forensic visibility into data access.

title: Database service account uses shared credentials
description: The same database service account credential is used by multiple application services.

title: No centralized log aggregation for production servers
description: Production server logs are stored locally with no forwarding to a central log aggregation platform, limiting incident detection.

title: Session tokens not invalidated on logout
description: Logging out of the auth service does not revoke the issued session token server-side, allowing reuse until natural expiry.

title: CORS policy allows any origin on internal admin API
description: The internal admin configuration API returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * instead of restricting to trusted origins.

title: No account lockout after repeated failed logins
description: The identity provider does not lock or throttle accounts after repeated failed authentication attempts.

title: Treasury settlement API lacks transaction-level audit trail
description: Individual treasury settlement transactions are not logged with sufficient detail to reconstruct an audit trail.
